description: Estimate the 2026 Section 199A QBI deduction for one business, including the W-2 wage and UBIA phase-in and the $400 minimum for active businesses. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

active.description: Do you materially participate in the business?. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: yes = Yes; no = No.

capGain.description: Net capital gain (including qualified dividends) (US dollars). Reduces the overall 20% of taxable income limit.

endJoint.description: 2026 phase-in range end, joint return (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 553500 USD from IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32, section 4.26, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is joint; ignored otherwise.

Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is other; ignored otherwise.

filing.description: Filing status. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: other = Single, head of household or qualifying surviving spouse; joint = Married filing jointly; mfs = Married filing separately.

qbi.description: Qualified business income from the business (US dollars). Net profit from the trade or business after the deductible half of SE tax, self-employed health insurance and retirement contributions tied to it.

taxable.description: Taxable income before the QBI deduction (US dollars). Your whole return’s taxable income figured before this deduction.
